methodology: To perform the analysis, I systematically decomposed the provided information into atomic units by identifying distinct requirements, features, and behaviors described in the text. Each unit was defined to be independent, specific, and implementable.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Rule 90 defines the next state of a cell as the XOR of its two neighbors.
The state advances by one time step per clock cycle.
The load input initializes the state with a 512-bit data input.
spec_atomic_units: The module implements a 512-cell one-dimensional cellular automaton based on Rule 90.
The next state of each cell is determined by the XOR of its two neighbors.
The system updates its state on the rising edge of the clock.
The load signal initializes the state with the provided data input.
The XOR operations for all cells are computed in parallel.
The design ensures minimal delay through balanced logic levels.
